title: Ghost story
raw_story:
A young person enters an abandoned house on a dare, believing ghosts are just stories. During the night, strange sounds lead them upstairs to a room with an old mirror.

At first, everything seems normal. Then the mirror reflection begins behaving differently from the real person. The person panics, but the reflection slowly becomes calm and lifelike.

By morning, the person walks out of the house and returns to their friends, shaken but alive.

Twist: the one who came out is actually the reflection. The real person is trapped inside the mirror, silently watching the world continue without them.
